column1: # Built-in (bottom) microphone -> ABOX WDMA1 (hw:0,13), plain AP capture.
# Taken from Samsung's /vendor/etc/mixer_paths_r18.xml: <path name="dev-main-mic">
# plus <path name="gain-media-mic">, plus the NSRC0 source select. Verified on
# device by loopback: a 1 kHz tone played on the speaker was captured at
# 1 kHz-bin 153.5 (rms 217) against a 0.00 / rms 0.7 noise floor.
# Deliberately NOT Samsung's full "media-mic" path. It pulls in
# route-ap-record, which sets ABOX WDMA1_EN=On and VPCMIN_DAI0_EN=On with
# VPCMIN_DAI0_A=WDMA1. That hands WDMA1 to the Calliope DSP's MMAP voice-input
# pipeline, which then waits for an MMAP consumer that only Samsung's
# libaudioproxy opens - the DSP logs "VPCMIN DAI0 not opened yet" every 125 ms,
# no data ever reaches the AP and every read fails with EIO. With both hooks
# off, WDMA1 streams to the AP normally. They are pinned Off below so a
# leftover or future default cannot re-enable them.
# GAIN: IN3R Digital Volume is 168 (+20 dB), not Samsung's 96. The control
# runs 0..191 in 0.5 dB steps from -64 dB, so Samsung's gain-media-mic value
# of 96 is -16 dB - their HAL/DSP adds its own gain on top, which we do not
# have. At 96 speech recorded around -45..-50 dBFS and played back as near
# silence. Measured by loopback (1 kHz on the speaker, played straight to
# hw:0,1 with the PulseAudio sink suspended, captured through PulseAudio):
#   128 (  0 dB) tone peak  503 (-36 dBFS)  noise rms 10
#   160 (+16 dB) tone peak 3165 (-20 dBFS)  noise rms 22
#   176 (+24 dB) tone peak 8296 (-12 dBFS)  noise rms 98, no clipping
# 168 puts normal speech near -10 dBFS with headroom for loud voices.
# Do NOT experiment by opening the abox_vdma capture devices (hw:1,x) while
# WDMA1 is open: that combination hung audio tasks and the kernel's hung-task
# panic reset the phone, repeatedly.
LHPF1 Input 1
ISRC1INT1 Input 1
AIF1TX1 Input 1
AIF1TX2 Input 1
DMIC1 Switch
IN3R Digital Volume
ABOX NSRC0
ABOX SIFM0
ABOX WDMA1_EN
ABOX VPCMIN_DAI0_EN
